# moxi v2 proof catalog

Date: 2026-10-14. Belongs to `DESIGN.md` (sections cited as "D 3.2"). Probes: `PROBES.md`.
Every assumption the design rests on has one proof here. A failed proof changes the code; a
failed **architecture-deciding** proof changes the design, as its row says.

## How to read this file

**Kind**
- **AD** = architecture-deciding. If it fails, the design changes (the row says how).
- **PL** = product-level. If it fails, the code is wrong; the design stays.

**Check type**
- **Gate**: deterministic. It waits for complete final states, uses fake clocks, has no retries
  and no short timeouts. A new or changed test file passes 20 runs in a row, also with all CPU
  cores busy, before it merges (AGENTS no-flaky rule).
- **Measure**: a timing or memory number. Non-gating job, median of 5 runs, compared with the
  stated threshold to make a decision. Timing is never a required gate.
- **Live**: needs a live game session with Matthias, after code review. Not now.
- **Review**: checked by Opus in a pull request.

**Where it runs**
- **N** = Vitest in Node (local headless and CI Linux).
- **B** = Vitest browser mode, headless Chromium (local headless and CI Linux).
- **E** = Playwright Electron on the fixture client, **CI only**, never as windows on
  Matthias's Mac. **E3** = Linux on every pull request, Windows and macOS nightly and on tags.
- **Pk** = packaged build in CI.
- **C** = corpus lane: Node on a machine with the cached ArenaNet builds (Matthias's Mac, no
  window). ArenaNet files never go into GitHub caches (R8 D-6).
- **K** = registry CI (`gwasm-dev/moxi-registry`).
- **L** = live session (deferred).

**Fixtures (test tooling, never shipped):** `fixture-client` (exists), `fixture-busy` (main loop
burns N ms per frame), `fixture-world` (generated memory structures plus the matching generated
locator), `fixture-actions` (exported functions that record calls and `inFlight`), chaos plugins
under `apps/plugin-host/test-fixtures/`, a kitchen-sink plugin that uses every launch element, a
fixture registry and a GitHub-like fixture server reached through Dev-only base URLs (like
`MOXI_DATA_DIR`), refused in packaged builds.

**Status**
- **proven**: an automated test in the repo passes today.
- **partly**: some of the claim has evidence (cited); the rest is open.
- **unproven**: no evidence yet.

## Summary

| | Count |
| --- | --- |
| Proofs | 79 |
| Architecture-deciding (AD) | 21: P1, P3, P5, P6, P9, P10, P11, P12, P19, P20, P26, P29, P30, P34, P40, P43, P48, P50, P53, P55, P73 |
| Status proven / partly / unproven | 0 / 16 / 63 |
| Gate / Measure / Live / Review (main type) | 71 / 4 / 2 / 2 (7 of the Gates also record a Measure; P26 also needs a review) |

No design claim is fully proven today. The strongest existing evidence: the worker isolation
e2e (8 probes, Linux CI; it also proves a per-partition handler for the privileged `moxi`
scheme), probe 02 memory (2.5 MiB per worker, Electron 43, macOS), the Hub
contract suite (18 tests against faked state), and R2's offline witness check (21 of 21 values
on 7 ArenaNet builds, not yet a repo test).

## Architecture-deciding proofs and what each failure changes

| Proof | If it fails |
| --- | --- |
| P1 | APIs deleted in the prelude or blocked at session level; no reads or `net:` plugins until 0 hits |
| P3 | `net:` stays off until runtime code generation is blocked |
| P5, P73 | the released Linux package changes (`.deb` only; AppImage ships only with plugins from other sources off) |
| P6 | the applier leaves the game renderer (PB17 path) |
| P9 | the authoring runtime is reworked (Remote DOM fallback) |
| P10 | one worker per (install, session) with the host runtime |
| P11 | slim HUD runtime, idle stop, cap on running unverified plugins |
| P12 | child components instead of data props |
| P19 | compiler pinned to the host's Vue minor; at most 2 runtimes |
| P20 | Main drives the watchdog with its own clock |
| P26 | new elements, or the iframe-tier question |
| P29, P30 | HUD apply batching; then PB17 decides a Hub view |
| P34 | read-or-internet replaced by disclosure and review flags (only if Matthias rejects it) |
| P40 | no third-party actions until host-held activation is redesigned |
| P43 | Main logs after the fact; the QA allowlist moves into the game renderer |
| P48 | actions through the game's work queue or a side module |
| P50 | facts only from signed locators, no local matching |
| P53 | readers move into a side module |
| P55 | add `ws` (pure JavaScript) to the Main network stack |
